name: The Met High School Internship Program in Museum Education (Spring)
what_you_do: Spend 40 hours this spring in a Met education team such as Teen Programs, Family Programs, Access Programs or Social Media. You go to Teen Fridays and monthly check-ins, and help run the Teens Take The Met night.
grades: 10th or 11th grade, or working on a High School Equivalency
who_can_apply: Students in grade 10 or 11 (or getting a High School Equivalency) who attend a high school or home school in New York City. You need working papers, a Social Security Number or ITIN, a parent or guardian's consent, and must not have done another Met internship.
pay_detail: $1,100 stipend when you finish, which the page says matches New York State minimum wage law.
duration: 40 hours, about 2 to 4 hours a week from Feb 9 to May 28, 2027, plus a Jan 23 bootcamp, monthly Saturday check-ins and three Teen Fridays.
deadline_text: Apply by Friday, October 16, 2026, 6 pm ET. Interview notices by Friday, December 4, 2026.
how_to_apply: Online application form, short essays, and one letter of recommendation from an adult who is not related to you. Finalists do an in-person group interview.
notes: All listed dates are mandatory, and a parent or guardian must come to the Jan 16, 2027 reception. The deadline is the same day this card was checked, so if you missed it, look for the summer internship, which also takes students from New Jersey and Connecticut.
